claims.text: Caldera House is in the heart of Teton Village, a few feet from the Jackson Hole Mountain Resort tram.

findings.quote: Caldera House is ideally situated in the heart of Teton Village, just a few feet from the Jackson Hole Mountain Resort tram

claims.text: Grand Teton National Park is a short drive from the hotel.

findings.quote: a short drive to Grand Teton National Park

claims.text: Caldera House is an intimate boutique hotel beneath the mountains of Jackson Hole.

findings.quote: An intimate boutique hotel nestled beneath the mountains of Jackson Hole in Teton Village

claims.text: The hotel has modern furnishings from designers such as John Pawson and Patricia Urquiola.

findings.quote: Modern furnishings from designers such as John Pawson and Patricia Urquiola.

claims.text: Each suite has its own chef's kitchen and a spacious dining room.

findings.quote: Each equipped with its own chef’s kitchen and spacious dining room, our suites serve as excellent spaces to host a private dinner.

claims.text: The Socorro Suite is the most private two-bedroom suite and has its own library.

findings.quote: The most private of our two-bedroom suites, Socorro's is an airy and truly home-like space complete with its own well-curated library.

claims.text: The Kari Kari Suite has views of Sleeping Indian mountain in the distance.

findings.quote: With views of Sleeping Indian mountain in the distance, the Kari Kari Suite offers a sense of peace and quietude.

claims.text: The Taupo Suite is designed as a modernist sky retreat with a darker color palette and rich textiles.

findings.quote: Designed as a modernist sky retreat, the Taupo Suite creates an unmistakably inviting mood with its darker color palette and rich textiles.

claims.text: Massages and therapies are available in the treatment room or in-suite on request.

findings.quote: A number of massages and therapies are available in our treatment room or in-suite upon request.

claims.text: The Mudroom sports shop on the ground level was founded by Jackson Hole local Gov Carrigan.

findings.quote: Tucked into the ground level of Caldera House, Mudroom is a specialty mountain shop
Founded by Jackson Hole local legend Gov Carrigan

claims.text: Corsa, the hotel's restaurant, nods to authentic trattorias in the Italian Alps.

findings.quote: Corsa was created to capture the rustic and laid-back vibe of Jackson Hole, while nodding to authentic trattorias in the Italian Alps.

claims.text: The hotel offers valet parking and a ski concierge.

findings.quote: it's worth it for the valet parking alone (Jackson Hole resort has zero parking) and the ski concierge

claims.text: The Taupo four-bedroom suite has a heated terrace, a firepit and a soaking tub in the bathroom.

findings.quote: We were in the four-bedroom suite, Taupo (there are just eight rooms in total), with a heated terrace, firepit and a soaking tub in the bathroom

claims.text: Guests have 24-hour access to a fitness studio with Peloton bikes, a heated outdoor infinity plunge and a cedar dry sauna.

findings.quote: Guests have 24-hour access to our fitness studio, equipped with Peloton bikes and yoga corner, as well as our heated outdoor infinity plunge and cedar dry sauna.

claims.text: The Yellowstone Suite, the largest two-bedroom suite, has slopeside views and its own in-house laundry.

findings.quote: The largest of our two-bedroom suites, Yellowstone features slopeside views and its own in-house laundry.

claims.text: The hotel offers a private stargazing tour in Grand Teton National Park, reserved for your group.

findings.quote: A private stargazing tour deep within Grand Teton National Park, reserved exclusively for your group

claims.text: A dedicated concierge customizes adventures from dog sledding and snow trekking to whitewater rafting and fly fishing.

findings.quote: with the help of your dedicated concierge
From dog sledding and snow trekking to whitewater rafting and fly fishing, we customize every adventure to suit your seasonal tastes.

claims.text: The hotel recommends contacting it early so it can secure guides and activities before your stay.

findings.quote: We recommend contacting the hotel as soon as possible so we can secure the best guides and activities prior to your stay.

claims.text: Spa treatments require reservations in advance.

findings.quote: Reservations required in advance

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
